title: Live-provider runtime-verify ACs are accountBound and skip cleanly when the provider is unreachable
asA: operator running the project's CI pipeline without live-provider credentials configured
iWant: the runtime-verify layer to skip the live-provider smoke ACs with a stable-coded reason
soThat: CI does not fail and the honest coverage state is on the record

acceptanceCriteria.description: Every TC bound to a runtime-verify AC that targets a live public provider carries an `accountBound` flag; the runtime-verify runner honours the flag by skipping and emitting a stable-coded reason.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a project scratch tree with this blueprint applied, one project-authored TC bound to AC-10110-2 flagged `accountBound`, and no live-provider credentials in the runtime environment
acceptanceCriteria.when: `rcf audit coverage --strict` reports the coverage state and the runtime-verify runner is invoked
acceptanceCriteria.then: the coverage report lists the AC as covered by a TC whose latest run outcome is `skipped` with reason `OAUTH2_LIVE_PROVIDER_UNREACHABLE`; the pipeline exit code is 0; the audit log records one `oauth2.accountbound_skip` event carrying the AC id and the missing-credential class

acceptanceCriteria.description: A live public-provider smoke against a real IdP (Google, GitHub, Microsoft, or a corporate SSO the project has credentials for) completes a full authorisation-code + PKCE round-trip and issues a project session whose Principal carries the live provider's id.
acceptanceCriteria.given: live-provider credentials configured in the runtime environment and the project's redirect URI registered at the provider's console (operator-authored, out of the blueprint's mechanism reach)
acceptanceCriteria.when: the operator drives a real browser through the sign-in surface at the live provider
acceptanceCriteria.then: the flow completes; a project session cookie is set with the same shape as AC-10101-3; `request.auth.provider` equals the live provider's declared id; the project-authored TC for this AC records a `pass` outcome
